description: Nick Perry Digital builds websites and handles local SEO for businesses on Colorado's Western Slope.
tagline: Websites and local SEO on Colorado's Western Slope
ctaBandText: Tell me the towns you serve and the jobs you want more of. I will tell you whether a website, a Google listing, or a monthly plan is the right next step. The call is free.
pricingIntro: Straightforward prices for a Western Slope business that wants a site and a Google listing that work together. The standard build and the two monthly plans are posted. Anything outside that scope is quoted before work starts.
pricingMetaDescription: Website build $1,000 with 90 days of SEO. Monthly plans at $850 and $1,500. Optional $150 care plan. No long-term contract.
comparisonNote: Local link and press outreach is research and contact on your behalf. If a publisher or sponsor charges a placement fee, they bill that fee. It is not folded into the monthly price.

guarantees: Monthly plans have no long-term contract. You can stop at the end of a month.
You own the website, the domain, and the content.
The $1,000 website build includes an SEO-ready site, Google Business Profile setup, and 90 days of SEO.
The price is set before work starts. The agreed scope does not grow into a surprise invoice.
The $150 monthly care plan is optional. It covers hosting, security updates, software updates, and small edits.
Monthly plans include a named contact and a written report each month.
If a plan includes local press or sponsorship outreach, any placement fee is billed by the publisher or organization, not hidden in the monthly price.
